topic.label: Design
topic.desc: Design: shaping visual, interactive, product and spatial artifacts through research, form-making, prototyping and critique.

concepts: Understanding people, contexts and needs through interviews, observation and synthesis before committing to a form.
Composition, color, imagery and hierarchy used to communicate a message clearly in print and on screen.
The selection, pairing and setting of type for legibility, tone and rhythm across media.
Designing how people move through digital products: flows, states, feedback and information architecture.
Designing physical objects for function, ergonomics, materials and manufacture.
Movements, principles and critical vocabulary used to evaluate and situate design work, including accessibility and ethics.
skills: Writes a research plan and interview guide for a design question and checks questions for leading or biased wording.
Clusters interview notes into themes and personas and checks every insight against quoted evidence.
Runs task-based usability tests on a prototype and checks findings by severity and frequency across participants.
Arranges content on a grid with a clear visual hierarchy and checks alignment, spacing and reading order.
Builds a color palette with semantic roles and checks contrast ratios for every foreground and background pair.
Develops logo, mark and identity guidelines for a brief and checks consistency across sample applications.
Selects complementary typefaces for a brief and checks legibility at body and display sizes.
Defines a modular type scale with line heights and checks vertical rhythm across breakpoints.
Produces low-fidelity wireframes of screens and flows and checks that every user task has a complete path.
Builds clickable prototypes with states and transitions and checks them against the specified flow.
Organizes content into navigation and labeling schemes and checks findability with card sort results.
Generates form concepts through sketch iterations and checks each against the functional requirements list.
Evaluates product dimensions against anthropometric data and checks reach, grip and posture limits.
Chooses materials and manufacturing processes for a part and checks cost, strength and sustainability trade-offs.
Writes structured critique of a design against its goals and principles and checks each claim against visible evidence.
Audits designs against WCAG criteria and checks contrast, focus order, target size and screen reader labels.
Places a work within design history movements and checks attributions against cited sources.
